name: buffalo_herd_resting
description: Cape buffalo herd lying at rest in grass, side-on: eight lying buffalo in a staggered line (4 behind facing right at 4 ground heights, 4 in front facing left with heads raised), every head up at 1.3x with clear air round each pair of horns, small gaps between rumps, bulls and cows mixed, calm. Anchor bottom-centre, x -750..750, y -280..0. Silhouette-safe (8 horned heads on the skyline).
